description: Recommend buying 21 diesel and 5 gas Access Transit buses.
Funded by $23.5 million borrowing and $23,900 from reserves.
Addresses federal funding denial and bus delivery delays.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Saskatoon's electric buses experienced power train issues; winter performance needs assessment.
Taxpayers will fund $23.5 million through city borrowing for bus purchases.
Federal zero-emission transit funding was denied, impacting the city's fleet transition.
Administration will present an updated 10-year fleet renewal strategy in Q2 2025.

description: Saskatoon will permit shared e-scooters on public roads.
City will select up to two e-scooter vendors.
Traffic Bylaw 7200 will be amended for e-scooters.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Councillor Donauer questioned the five-year term
Nearly 20,000 unique riders used shared e-scooters last year.
City Solicitor stated holding vendors accountable for rider actions would be extremely difficult.
Unknown how many e-scooter ER visits were due to not wearing a helmet.
City surveys showed 53-64% public support for continuing the e-scooter program.
226 riders used a reduced price option for e-scooter access.
E-scooter use estimated to have averted 40 tons of CO2 emissions.
Administration will bring a report on private e-scooters by late spring/early summer 2025.
